## fetchMarket() function

Fetches a hydrated market by id.

Reads `eth_chainId` only when the viem client has no configured chain id, then reads `Midnight.toMarket(marketId)` and `Midnight.marketState(marketId)`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function fetchMarket(client: Client, params: MidnightFetchParams & {
    readonly marketId: Hash;
}): Promise<Market>;
```

Market instance.

## Exceptions

`UnsupportedChainIdError` when no address registry exists for the client chain id.

`UnknownAddressError` when the registry has no Midnight address for the client chain id.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.marketId`<!-- -->: Market id whose hydrated market state to read.

- `params.account`<!-- -->: Optional account used as the `from` field for the reads.

- `params.blockNumber`<!-- -->: Optional block number used for the reads.

- `params.blockTag`<!-- -->: Optional block tag used for the reads.

- `params.stateOverride`<!-- -->: Optional state override set used for the reads.

## Example


```ts
import { fetchMarket } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { createPublicClient, http } from "viem";
import { base } from "viem/chains";

const client = createPublicClient({ chain: base, transport: http() });
const market = await fetchMarket(client, {
  marketId: "0x12590ae1aee324a005be565f3bcdd16dbf8daf7969b26c181c8b8f467dad9f67",
});
console.log(market.params.loanToken);
```
